definitions.explanation: The Buddhist concept of the continuous cycle of birth, death, and rebirth that all living beings undergo until they attain enlightenment.

examples.japanese: {輪廻|りんね}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{解脱|げだつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To be liberated from the cycle of rebirth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仏教|ぶっきょう}→仏教：11428_bukkyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{輪廻|りんね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教|おし}え→教え：01909_oshie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: In Buddhism, the teaching of reincarnation is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{魂|たましい}→魂：14639_tamashii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{輪廻|りんね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦やがて→やがて：03637_yagate⟧⟦{悟|さと}り→悟り：07773_satori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{至|いた}る→至る：02009_itaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the soul goes through repeated cycles of rebirth and eventually reaches enlightenment.

notes:
A key concept in Buddhism and Hinduism. In Japanese Buddhism, {輪廻|りんね} describes the cycle of suffering through repeated births and deaths in the six realms ({六道|ろくどう}). Attaining ⟦{悟|さと}り→悟り：07773_satori⟧ (enlightenment) allows one to escape this cycle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{輪廻転生|りんねてんしょう}→輪廻転生：20920_rinnetenshou⟧ (transmigration of souls, metempsychosis)
- {輪廻|りんね}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{逃|のが}れる→逃れる：10425_nogareru⟧ (to escape the cycle of rebirth)
- {輪廻|りんね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧ (to go through cycles of rebirth)

Also read as りんえ in some classical Buddhist texts, though りん⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ is the standard modern reading. Frequently appears in literature, anime, and games as a theme.
